name: VertiGo
maker: ETH Zurich and Disney Research Zurich
def: Remote controlled wall climbing robot on wheels, developed by ETH Zurich and Disney Research Zurich, that uses two fully tilting propellers to push itself onto and up walls.
facts: Its propellers can tilt through a full 360 degrees
Built on a carbon fiber baseplate with 3D printed joints
Can roll across the floor and then move onto a vertical wall
